difficulty_mismatches.root_cause: Template pipeline assigns Moderate label but DifficultyScore is 2 (should be Moderate-Easy — label does not exist). Score-2 items account for majority of mismatches. Additional score-1 items labeled Moderate (1→3 gap = major).

by_pack._analysis: Block-level matching shows all mismatches are minor (1 level). Multi-match issues across split-block architecture (Pack A/C/D) resolved by QuestionID-boundary parsing. Remaining major mismatch count of 227 is from cross-field label/score pairs within dual-block items where Difficulty label in metadata block differs from DifficultyScore in content block.

very_difficult_gap.evidence: Zero items across all 5 packs have DifficultyScore=5 or Difficulty label 'Very Difficult'. CAQS §6.1 target is 10% (250 items). Each pack has exactly 0.
very_difficult_gap.root_cause: Template-based authoring pipeline never produces tier-5 items. The 5-item rotation template cycles through Easy(1)/Moderate-Easy(2)/Moderate(3)/Difficult(4)/Moderate(3). Difficulty tier 5 requires multi-step calculations, judgment calls across competing frameworks, or synthesis of 3+ exhibits — none of which the template engine generates.
very_difficult_gap.not_a_calibration_failure: This is not mere mislabeling. The content was never authored at Very Difficult cognitive complexity. Recalibrating existing items upward would produce difficulty inflation. New content authoring is the only remedy.

evaluate_gap.evidence: Zero items across all 5 packs have CognitiveLevel='Evaluate'. CAQS §6.2 target is 15% (375 items). Only 10 items have Analyze (0.4% vs 25% target).
evaluate_gap.root_cause: Template authoring pipeline generates items at Remember/Understand/Apply levels almost exclusively. Evaluate-level items require open-ended judgment, scenario-based trade-off analysis, or multi-standard comparison — none of which the pipeline produces. Pack A and B have 1-3 Analyze items each; Pack E has zero Analyze.
evaluate_gap.not_a_calibration_failure: Existing items do not test at the Evaluate cognitive level. They test recall (Remember), concept matching (Understand), or formula application (Apply). Re-labeling Apply items as Evaluate would be a CAQS violation.

classification.negligible_rationale: Items with 1-level DifficultyScore mismatch due to missing Moderate-Easy label (cosmetic convention gap), or certified items whose only calibration issue is the label convention. Includes items in Packs A-C with well-calibrated content but wrong label tier due to 3-label inventory.
classification.acceptable_rationale: Certified items with minor non-blocking issues: 1-level diff mismatch where content quality is verified (DL-016 style metadata-shifted items where content block is correct), items with DL-013 boilerplate but otherwise substantive explanations, or Pack E items where short stems are by-design (separate pipeline) but educationally sound.
classification.requires_remediation_rationale: Sum of: 227 major DifficultyScore mismatches (2+ levels off) + 67 Certified DL-008 items (non-empty EW[CC] in learner pool) + 11 items missing key metadata fields. These items have either incorrect difficulty labels (Easy labeled as Moderate), missing governance fields, or learner-safety risks from wrong-answer explanations showing in correct-answer review slots.
